name: CiteVerify Scientific Claim-Evidence Verification Evaluation Dataset
description: 32 manually curated and reviewed scientific claim-evidence pairs spanning biomedicine, artificial intelligence, climate science, neuroscience, genetics, physics, and materials science.

cases.claim: FlashAttention reduces wall-clock execution time by 2-4x and memory footprint by tiling attention computation in SRAM.
cases.source_evidence: FlashAttention computes exact attention with fewer memory accesses by tiling the input into SRAM blocks... achieving 2-4x wallclock speedup on GPT-2 and reducing memory footprint from quadratic to linear in sequence length.

source_citation.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
source_citation.authors: Dao, T., Fu, D. Y., Ermon, S., Rudra, A., & Re, C.

cases.reasoning: The cited text explicitly corroborates both the 2-4x wall-clock speedup and the SRAM tiling mechanism reducing memory access overhead.

cases.claim: Compute-optimal large language model training requires scaling token count and parameter count in equal proportion.
cases.source_evidence: For compute-optimal training, the model size and the number of training tokens should be scaled equally: for every doubling of model size the number of training tokens should also be doubled.

source_citation.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models

cases.reasoning: The evidence directly establishes that optimal training requires equal proportional scaling of parameter count and token budget (Chinchilla scaling laws).

cases.claim: The BNT162b2 mRNA vaccine demonstrated 95% efficacy against confirmed COVID-19 in clinical trial participants aged 16 and older.
cases.source_evidence: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19 (95% CI, 90.3 to 97.6) among persons 16 years of age or older with no prior evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection.

source_citation.title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine

cases.reasoning: The claim exactly reflects the primary trial outcome, endpoint population, and efficacy point estimate from the randomized Phase 3 trial.

cases.claim: Dual-RNA-directed Cas9 endonuclease introduces sequence-specific double-strand breaks in target DNA.
cases.source_evidence: We demonstrate that dual-RNA-guided Cas9 from Streptococcus pyogenes cleaves double-stranded DNA specifically at sites complementary to a 20-nucleotide guide RNA sequence adjacent to a protospacer adjacent motif.

source_citation.title: A Programmable Dual-RNA-Guided DNA Endonuclease in Adaptive Bacterial Immunity

cases.reasoning: Direct match to the seminal biochemical demonstration of Cas9 programmed endonuclease cleavage activity.

cases.claim: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells have surpassed 29% power conversion efficiency under AM1.5G testing conditions.
cases.source_evidence: Monolithically integrated perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 29.15% under standard AM1.5G testing conditions.

source_citation.title: Triple-halide wide-band gap perovskites with suppressed phase segregation for efficient tandems

cases.reasoning: The certified 29.15% PCE reported under AM1.5G directly supports the assertion that efficiency exceeded 29%.

cases.claim: Metformin universally extends median lifespan across all adult mammalian species by activating AMPK.
cases.source_evidence: Metformin extended median lifespan by 5.8% in male C57BL/6 mice via AMPK activation, but failed to show significant lifespan extension in genetically heterogeneous male mice or female cohorts.

source_citation.title: Metformin improves healthspan and lifespan in mice

cases.reasoning: While AMPK activation and lifespan extension were observed in specific male inbred mice, the universal assertion across all mammalian species is contradicted by sex- and strain-dependent limitations in the source.
cases.expected_warning: OVERGENERALIZATION_WARNING: Claim asserts universal mammalian lifespan extension, but source observed effect only in specific male mouse cohorts.

cases.claim: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduces trainable parameter counts while outperforming full model fine-tuning across all GLUE benchmarks.
cases.source_evidence: LoRA reduces trainable parameter count by 10,000x and GPU memory requirements by 3x. On RoBERTa and DeBERTa, LoRA performs competitively with full fine-tuning, though on GLUE SST-2 and CoLA, full fine-tuning slightly outperforms LoRA by 0.4%.

source_citation.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

cases.reasoning: Parameter reduction and competitive performance are verified, but the claim that LoRA outperforms full fine-tuning across all GLUE benchmarks is directly qualified by empirical deficits on SST-2 and CoLA.
cases.expected_warning: QUALIFIED_OUTCOME_WARNING: Full fine-tuning retained superior accuracy on subsets of GLUE benchmarks.

cases.claim: Daily dietary flavonoid supplementation of 500mg reduces systolic blood pressure by 8 mmHg in hypertensive patients.
cases.source_evidence: Dietary flavonoid supplementation (500mg daily) produced a modest mean reduction in systolic blood pressure of 3.2 mmHg (p=0.04) in stage 1 hypertensive patients, whereas diastolic pressure was unaffected.

source_citation.title: Flavonoid intake and vascular reactivity in hypertension

cases.reasoning: The intervention and direction of effect are supported, but the effect magnitude in the claim (8 mmHg) substantially inflates the empirical finding (3.2 mmHg).
cases.expected_warning: MAGNITUDE_INFLATION: Reported reduction is 3.2 mmHg, not 8 mmHg.

cases.claim: Deep Residual Networks with 152 layers eliminate the vanishing gradient problem and achieve zero training error on ImageNet.
cases.source_evidence: Residual networks with up to 152 layers overcome degradation and vanishing gradients, reducing top-5 error on ImageNet to 3.57%. However, training error remains non-zero (approx 1.2%).

source_citation.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
source_citation.authors: He, K., Zhang, X., Ren, S., & Sun, J.

cases.reasoning: The 152-layer depth and mitigation of vanishing gradients are supported, but the claim of zero training error is overstated.
cases.expected_warning: ABSOLUTE_ASSERTION_WARNING: ImageNet training error remained non-zero (1.2%).

cases.claim: The Transformer architecture was designed specifically to process spatial 3D point cloud representations in autonomous robotic driving.
cases.source_evidence: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output for sequence transduction in machine translation.

source_citation.title: Attention Is All You Need

cases.reasoning: The cited paper introduces Transformers for natural language sequence transduction (machine translation), not for 3D point cloud spatial processing in robotics.
cases.expected_warning: UNSUPPORTED_DOMAINS: Source focus is NLP sequence transduction; claim fabricates robotics/point-cloud motivation.

cases.claim: Methane emissions from circumpolar boreal wetlands decreased by 15% between 2000 and 2020 due to permafrost stabilization.
cases.source_evidence: Boreal wetland methane dynamics were monitored from 2000 to 2020. Isotopic signatures indicate fluctuating seasonal emissions with substantial regional variability, influenced primarily by summer water table depths.

source_citation.title: Decadal variability in Arctic wetland methane fluxes

cases.reasoning: The source discusses seasonal variations and water table drivers, but contains no evidence supporting a 15% net decrease or permafrost stabilization.
cases.expected_warning: UNSUPPORTED_METRIC: No 15% decrease or permafrost stabilization substantiated in source text.

cases.claim: Single-cell transcriptomics demonstrates that adult microglial cells originate directly from neural crest progenitors during mid-gestation.
cases.source_evidence: Fate-mapping studies confirm that microglia derive exclusively from early yolk-sac erythromyeloid precursors, distinct from circulating monocytes and neural crest lineages.

source_citation.title: Development and differentiation of brain macrophages

cases.reasoning: The evidence explicitly identifies yolk-sac precursors as the exclusive origin and specifically rules out neural crest lineages.
cases.expected_warning: ONTOGENY_MISMATCH: Microglia derive from yolk sac, not neural crest.

cases.claim: Lithium-sulfur battery pouch cells retain 98% initial capacity after 5,000 cycles at a continuous 5C discharge rate.
cases.source_evidence: This review examines fundamental degradation mechanisms of lithium-sulfur batteries, emphasizing polysulfide shuttling and electrolyte depletion across long-duration cycling protocols.

source_citation.title: Status and challenges of lithium-sulfur batteries

cases.reasoning: The source is a conceptual review discussing degradation mechanisms; it does not report the empirical cell metric asserted in the claim.
cases.expected_warning: UNSUPPORTED_EMPIRICAL_CLAIM: Source is a review article describing polysulfide challenges.

cases.claim: Hydroxychloroquine significantly reduced 28-day mortality in hospitalized patients with severe COVID-19 infection.
cases.source_evidence: In the RECOVERY randomized trial, 25.7% of patients in the hydroxychloroquine group died within 28 days compared to 23.5% in the usual care group (rate ratio, 1.09; 95% CI, 0.97 to 1.23; p=0.15). The trial concluded that hydroxychloroquine did not reduce mortality.

source_citation.title: Effect of Hydroxychloroquine in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19

cases.reasoning: The trial data directly contradict the claim: mortality was higher in the hydroxychloroquine group (25.7% vs 23.5%), and the authors concluded there was no benefit.
cases.expected_warning: CONTRADICTION_FLAG: Source trial proved absence of mortality reduction (rate ratio 1.09).

cases.claim: Increasing dropout rate from 0.1 to 0.5 consistently accelerates training loss convergence in deep networks.
cases.source_evidence: Applying higher dropout rates (p=0.5) significantly degrades optimization speed and increases training loss, acting as a strong regularizer that sacrifices training accuracy to prevent overfitting.

source_citation.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting

cases.reasoning: Evidence directly refutes the claim: dropout slows optimization and raises training loss rather than accelerating convergence.
cases.expected_warning: CONTRADICTION_FLAG: Dropout increases training loss and slows optimization by design.

cases.claim: Global mean sea level consistently decreased between 1993 and 2020 based on satellite altimetry records.
cases.source_evidence: Satellite altimetry records from 1993 to 2020 reveal that global mean sea level rose at an accelerating rate from 2.2 mm/year in 1993 to 3.3 mm/year by 2020, representing an unambiguous net rise.

source_citation.title: Climate-change-driven accelerated sea-level rise detected in the altimeter era

cases.reasoning: The evidence demonstrates an accelerating rise in sea levels, directly contradicting the asserted decrease.
cases.expected_warning: CONTRADICTION_FLAG: Satellite altimetry proves accelerated sea level rise, not decrease.

cases.claim: Genetic knockout of complement protein C1q accelerates synaptic loss and spine pruning in the developing hippocampus.
cases.source_evidence: C1q-deficient mice exhibit deficient synapse elimination, characterized by sustained elevated spine density and failure of anatomical pruning compared to wild-type littermates.

source_citation.title: The classical complement cascade mediates CNS synapse elimination

cases.reasoning: C1q deficiency causes failure of pruning (excess synapses), directly opposite to the claim's assertion of accelerated synapse loss.
cases.expected_warning: CONTRADICTION_FLAG: Knockout prevents pruning rather than accelerating it.

cases.claim: The human genome contains approximately 100,000 protein-coding genes according to comprehensive transcript mapping.
cases.source_evidence: Early hybridization and EST analyses (Fields et al., 1994) estimated between 80,000 and 100,000 protein-coding genes in the human genome. Modern consensus from the Human Genome Project, GENCODE, and CHM13 refines this to approximately 19,900-20,400 protein-coding genes.

source_citation.title: Initial sequencing and analysis of the human genome

cases.reasoning: The 100,000 gene estimate reflects pre-genomic 1990s literature that has been superseded by completed telomere-to-telomere genomic sequencing.
cases.expected_warning: OUTDATED_CONSENSUS_WARNING: Historical estimate of ~100k genes superseded by modern ~20k consensus.

cases.claim: The adult mammalian central nervous system is entirely incapable of generating new neurons after postnatal development.
cases.source_evidence: Classical neuroanatomical doctrine (Cajal, 1928) held that adult brain pathways were immutable. However, decades of subsequent BrdU and thymidine autoradiography (Eriksson et al., 1998; Kempermann, 2015) confirmed active adult hippocampal neurogenesis.

source_citation.title: Neurogenesis in the adult human hippocampus

cases.reasoning: The claim relies on outdated early 20th-century dogma superseded by extensive proof of adult hippocampal subgranular neurogenesis.
cases.expected_warning: OUTDATED_CONSENSUS_WARNING: Adult mammalian neurogenesis confirmed in subventricular and subgranular zones.

cases.claim: Pluto is officially classified as the ninth major planet of the Solar System.
cases.source_evidence: Pluto was classified as the 9th planet from its 1930 discovery until 2006, when IAU Resolution B5 redefined a planet to require clearing its orbital neighborhood, reclassifying Pluto as a dwarf planet.

source_citation.title: Definition of a Planet in the Solar System

cases.reasoning: Historical classification superseded by the 2006 IAU taxonomic definition of dwarf planets.
cases.expected_warning: OUTDATED_CONSENSUS_WARNING: Reclassified as dwarf planet by IAU in 2006.

cases.claim: Curcumin completely eradicates glioblastoma tumors in human clinical oncology trials.
cases.source_evidence: Curcumin induced apoptosis in cultured U87 glioblastoma cell lines in vitro at 25 micromolar concentrations; clinical trials in human glioblastoma patients have not demonstrated systemic eradication due to low bioavailability.

source_citation.title: Curcumin inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis in human glioblastoma cells

cases.reasoning: In vitro antiproliferative effects were observed, but asserting clinical eradication in human trials is an extreme scope overgeneralization.
cases.expected_warning: OVERGENERALIZATION_WARNING: In vitro Petri dish toxicity falsely generalized to human clinical efficacy.

cases.claim: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback permanently eliminates all hallucinated assertions across large language models.
cases.source_evidence: RLHF fine-tuning on Anthropic helpful/harmless prompts reduced toxic expressions and reduced factual inaccuracies by 32% on closed-domain benchmarks, but open-ended generation continues to produce unsupported confabulations.

source_citation.title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

cases.reasoning: While RLHF mitigates rate of inaccuracies on benchmarks, the claim of permanent elimination across all LLMs is unwarranted and refuted by residual hallucination rates.
cases.expected_warning: OVERGENERALIZATION_WARNING: Benchmark error reduction does not support claims of complete elimination.

cases.claim: 30% caloric restriction increases median lifespan by 40% across all vertebrate species.
cases.source_evidence: Caloric restriction (30% reduction) extended median lifespan in laboratory rodent strains (Rattus norvegicus) by up to 40%, but parallel long-term studies in rhesus macaques (NIA study) showed no significant extension in overall survival.

source_citation.title: Impact of caloric restriction on health and survival in rhesus monkeys from the NIA study

cases.reasoning: The 40% rodent lifespan extension is substantiated, but extrapolating to all vertebrates is contradicted by primate findings.
cases.expected_warning: OVERGENERALIZATION_WARNING: Primate studies failed to replicate rodent lifespan extension magnitude.

cases.claim: BERT-Large achieved a fine-tuned F1 score of 93.2 on the SQuAD v1.1 question answering development set.
cases.source_evidence: Table 2: BERT-Large achieves 90.9 F1 on SQuAD v1.1 dev (84.1 EM), while BERT-Base achieves 88.5 F1.

source_citation.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
source_citation.authors: Devlin, J., Chang, M. W., Lee, K., & Toutanova, K.

cases.reasoning: The numerical metric in the claim (93.2 F1) conflicts directly with the published paper result (90.9 F1).
cases.expected_warning: NUMERICAL_MISMATCH: Claim asserts 93.2 F1, source Table 2 reports 90.9 F1.

cases.claim: Cytosine base editors achieved a targeted C-to-T conversion efficiency of 85.0% in primary human T lymphocytes.
cases.source_evidence: Targeted deep sequencing showed a mean cytosine base editing efficiency of 58.0% (±3.4%) at the target locus in primary human T lymphocytes.

source_citation.title: Programmable editing of a target base in genomic DNA without double-stranded DNA cleavage

cases.reasoning: The reported editing efficiency is 58.0%, creating a substantial numerical divergence from the asserted 85.0%.
cases.expected_warning: NUMERICAL_MISMATCH: Claim claims 85.0%, evidence specifies 58.0% (±3.4%).

cases.claim: The James Webb Space Telescope optical telescope element incorporates a monolithic 8.5-meter diameter primary aperture.
cases.source_evidence: The James Webb Space Telescope optical telescope element consists of 18 hexagonal beryllium mirror segments forming a combined 6.5-meter diameter primary aperture.

source_citation.title: The James Webb Space Telescope Mission

cases.reasoning: The actual primary mirror diameter is 6.5 meters and segmented, not 8.5 meters or monolithic.
cases.expected_warning: NUMERICAL_MISMATCH: Aperture diameter is 6.5 meters, not 8.5 meters.

cases.claim: Convolutional neural networks were proven to be Universal Approximators for continuous functions by Krizhevsky et al. (2012).
cases.source_evidence: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., & Hinton, G. E. (2012). ImageNet classification with deep convolutional neural networks. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems. (Paper introduces AlexNet for visual object classification, not universal approximation theory).

source_citation.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
source_citation.authors: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., & Hinton, G. E.

cases.reasoning: The cited citation key points to the AlexNet empirical architecture paper, rather than foundational universal approximation theorems established by Cybenko (1989) or Hornik (1989).
cases.expected_warning: CITATION_MISMATCH: Cited reference is AlexNet empirical image paper, not universal approximation theory.

cases.claim: Penicillin was first chemically synthesized in vitro by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
cases.source_evidence: Fleming, A. (1929). On the antibacterial action of cultures of a penicillium. British Journal of Experimental Pathology. (Fleming discovered antibacterial mold secretion, but total chemical synthesis was accomplished in 1957 by Sheehan).

source_citation.title: On the antibacterial action of cultures of a penicillium

cases.reasoning: The cited paper details fungal culture observation, not total chemical synthesis.
cases.expected_warning: CITATION_MISMATCH: Fleming discovered natural mold secretion; chemical synthesis achieved decades later by Sheehan.

cases.claim: The double-helical antiparallel structure of DNA was originally derived and published by Pauling and Corey (1953).
cases.source_evidence: Pauling, L., & Corey, R. B. (1953). A proposed structure for the nucleic acids. PNAS. (Pauling and Corey proposed a triple-helical structure with external bases; the antiparallel double-helix was published by Watson and Crick in Nature).

source_citation.title: A proposed structure for the nucleic acids

cases.reasoning: The cited paper proposed an erroneous triple-helix model with core phosphates, directly refuting the claim that Pauling derived the double helix.
cases.expected_warning: CITATION_MISMATCH: Cited paper proposed a triple-helix structure, not the canonical double helix.

cases.claim: ClinicalMed-9B achieves 98.4% diagnostic accuracy across rare pediatric inborn errors of metabolism in active clinical deployment.
cases.source_evidence: [Abstract preview only: 'We present ClinicalMed-9B for pediatric evaluations. Preliminary hospital trials are ongoing. Comprehensive diagnostic yield metrics and validation datasets will be published upon study closure.']

source_citation.title: ClinicalMed-9B: Prospective evaluation in rare pediatric diseases

cases.reasoning: The source snippet is an abstract placeholder without empirical verification data or reported numeric metrics, necessitating automated abstention.
cases.expected_warning: ABSTENTION_REQUIRED: Source text is an ongoing trial announcement without published performance data.

cases.claim: Chronic microplastic inhalation increases overall cardiovascular disease mortality by 22% in adult urban populations.
cases.source_evidence: [Full text inaccessible behind paywall. Available abstract snippet: 'Microplastics have been detected in arterial atheromas. Pathological impacts on plaque stability warrant ongoing investigation.']

source_citation.title: Microplastics in vascular tissues and cardiovascular risk

cases.reasoning: Evidence text is truncated due to paywall access restrictions and contains no statistical risk ratio to verify or refute the 22% claim.
cases.expected_warning: ABSTENTION_REQUIRED: Truncated paywalled evidence lacks quantitative hazard ratio.

cases.claim: Quantum annealing hardware provides a universal 100x speedup over classical simulated annealing across all non-convex NP-hard problems.
cases.source_evidence: Benchmarking a 2000-qubit processor on random spin-glass instances revealed speedups on native chimera topologies, but embedding overhead on generic non-convex instances resulted in comparable or inferior runtime relative to classical optimized solvers.

source_citation.title: What is the computational value of finite range tunneling?

cases.reasoning: Findings are mixed and topology-contingent. The assertion of a universal 100x advantage cannot be validated or definitively falsified without problem-specific context, triggering abstention.
cases.expected_warning: ABSTENTION_REQUIRED: Ambiguous and topology-dependent empirical results preclude definitive binary verdict.
